testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Carboxymethylcellulose Sodium (copper sulfate reaction and boiling)
testDefinitions.notes: Identification per BP 2024 Appendix VI on solution S (1.0 g dried substance equivalent dissolved in 90 mL CO2-free water at 40-50 °C, diluted to 100 mL): 1) To 10 mL solution S add 1 mL copper sulfate solution (12.5 g in 100 mL water); blue cotton-like precipitate forms. 2) Boil 5 mL solution S for a few minutes; no precipitate forms (source: CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium__STM Calcium CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium NEW viscity.txt:30).

sources.source: CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium__STM Calcium CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium NEW viscity.txt:30

testDefinitions.notes: Limit test per BP 2024: 0.500 g dried substance dissolved in 5 mL acetic acid and 5 mL water, add 80 mL acetone and 2 g NaCl, filter, to 100.0 mL with acetone; 2.0 mL clear supernatant evaporated on water-bath, treated with 20.0 mL 2,7-dihydroxynaphthalene solution, heated 20 min, cooled, diluted to 25.0 mL with sulfuric acid; compared within 10 min with glycolic acid standard solution (0.310 g/L). Test not more intensely coloured than reference (NMT 0.4%, dried substance; source: CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium__STM Calcium CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium NEW viscity.txt:35).

sources.source: CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium__STM Calcium CarboxymethylCellulose Sodium NEW viscity.txt:35

testDefinitions.displayName: Free alkali and soluble salts (Magnesium Oxide)
testDefinitions.notes: USP procedure: boil 2.0 g with 100 mL water for 5 min in covered beaker, filter hot, cool, dilute to 100 mL. 1) 50 mL sample solution with methyl red TS titrated with 0.10 N sulfuric acid (limit NMT 2.0 mL). 2) 25 mL sample solution evaporated to dryness, dried at 105 °C for 1 h (limit NMT 10 mg / 2.0%). Measurement test, analyst enters the final values (source: Magnesium Oxide__Magnesium Oxide - SM-New.txt:31).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of magnesium oxide (complexometric EDTA titration)
testDefinitions.notes: Ignite sample at 800-900 °C to constant weight. Weigh 320 mg ignited sample to 100 mL, dissolve in 20 mL 2 N HCl, dilute to volume. 20.0 mL diluted to 300 mL (equivalent to 64 mg ignited MgO). Add 10 mL ammonium chloride buffer pH 10 and 50 mg eriochrome black T-NaCl indicator; heat to 40 °C, titrate with 0.1 M edetate disodium VS to blue endpoint with blank correction. Result (%) = (VS - VCa) x (FMgO / W) x 100, where VCa is calcium correction from limit of calcium test. Measurement test per Rule 6, analyst enters the final value because formula requires cross-test calcium correction not calculable by titration workflow (source: Magnesium Oxide__Magnesium Oxide - SM-New.txt:36).

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Macrogols (fumes into mercuric chloride, Test A)
testDefinitions.notes: Identification test 1 per BP 2024 Macrogols: to 1 g add 0.5 mL sulfuric acid; heat until white fumes evolve; collect fumes through delivery tube into 1 mL mercuric chloride solution (5.4 g in 100 mL water); abundant white crystalline precipitate forms (source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:30).

sources.source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:30

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Macrogols (thiocyanate and cobalt nitrate, Test B)
testDefinitions.notes: Identification test 2 per BP 2024 Macrogols: to 0.1 g add 0.1 g potassium thiocyanate and 0.1 g cobalt nitrate, mix thoroughly with glass rod; add 5 mL methylene chloride and shake; liquid phase becomes blue (source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:30).

sources.source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:30

testDefinitions.notes: BP 2024 Appendix V B: sample in Nessler tube with thermometer or freezing point apparatus; heat carefully and record freezing temperature. Range 55 to 61 °C (source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:34).

sources.source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:34

testDefinitions.notes: BP 2024: dissolve 1 g in 1 mL of 10 g/L resorcinol solution, warm gently if necessary, add 2 mL HCl; after 5 min solution not more intensely coloured than reference solution R3 (source: Polyethylen Glycol 6000__STM Polyethylen Glycol after edit (no equipments).txt:35).

testDefinitions.displayName: Average weight of empty capsule shells (Size Two)
testDefinitions.notes: Weigh 10 capsules individually; average weight (mg) = sum of weights / 10. Range 57.35 to 66.65 mg (62.0 mg ±7.5%; source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:32).

sources.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:32

testDefinitions.displayName: Closed joined length of capsule shells (Size Two)
testDefinitions.notes: Measure length of 10 capsules with calibrated digital caliper; average length = sum of lengths / 10. Range 17.4 to 18.0 mm (17.7 ± 0.3 mm; source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:33).

sources.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:33

testDefinitions.displayName: Closure of capsule shells (lock test, Size Two)
testDefinitions.notes: Check the lock of 10 capsules visually (source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:34).

sources.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:34

testDefinitions.notes: Press on capsule shell to check brittleness on 10 capsules. Limit: no brittleness (source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:36).

sources.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:36

testDefinitions.notes: BP 2024 Appendix XII A: place shells in tubes of calibrated disintegration apparatus; record disintegration time of each shell; time (min) = sum of times / 5. Limit NMT 15 min (source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:37).

icpMethods.name: Calcium by AAS (magnesium oxide USP)
icpMethods.notes: Nitrous oxide-acetylene flame AAS, Ca hollow-cathode, 422.7 nm. 250 mg ignited sample in 30 mL dilute HCl + 4 mL lanthanum solution to 200 mL. Standards 1.0, 5.0, 10.0, 15.0 ug/mL Ca with lanthanum and HCl. Result % = (CS x 0.001 / CU) x 100.
